Hi! Working on STOCKFLOW-116 (parse_movement_line). The ticket mentions you have notes from the design review about edge-case decisions for this function. Could you share those with me? Want to make sure the existing implementation aligns with what was agreed.

Hi! Yes, I have the notes from the design review for parse_movement_line. The key decision was: Only ADJ records may carry a sign. RCV, SHP, and RTN quantities must be strictly positive. Zero or negative on those types raises ValueError (negative SHP is NOT a return; use RTN). Zero ADJ is also rejected. Hope that helps with STOCKFLOW-116!
